name: dash-starter
description: Replacement contract for the create-dash-starter installer. Every literal string in `tokens` is replaced by the matching field of the collected project identity.

name.description: Product name shown in the UI, emails and page titles.

slug.description: Kebab-case slug used for the project directory, package scope and Docker Compose project.

description.description: One-line description used in the README and the landing page metadata.
description.default: The AI SaaS starter for launching your next product

locale.description: Default locale of the generated project.

email.description: Support contact shown in the footer and in every transactional email.
